description: Integrity record for the Module 3 engagement artifacts. Verify with scripts/verify_artifacts.py before trusting a prediction: a model or scaler that has silently changed produces plausible-looking but wrong output, which is far harder to notice than a crash.

calibrated_variant.description: Trained on per-subject-centred features, matching what backend/app/engagement/calibration.py already produces at inference. Not yet the production model - see ml/evaluation/README.md.
calibrated_variant.threshold_note: Chosen on validation for THIS artifact, not taken from the multi-seed average. The averaged study suggested 0.40, but this selected model is more conservative than average (argmax flag rate 0.051 against ~0.100), so an averaged threshold does not transfer to it. 0.34 rather than the 0.32 the selection rule picked: 0.32 keeps the flag rate under 0.25 on validation but drifts to 0.271 on test, while 0.34 stays under it on both.

measured.note: Test split, per-subject-centred features. Never used for selection.

caveats: Not the production model. ml/inference/model.py still loads the uncalibrated artifacts and still uses argmax.
Subject coverage 15/19 still leaves roughly one in five struggling learners never detected.
The flag rate roughly doubles, 0.123 to 0.214. Scope 6.4 asks for infrequent targeted support; whether one window in five qualifies is a product decision, not an ML one.
One train/test split. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation would be a stronger basis for these figures.
